recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-25407 unless future BR&R work intentionally changes the packaging quantity model.
issue_request: FHIR-25407 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked BR&R to change PackagedProductDefinition.package.quantity from Quantity to integer because it is a count of packaging items at that level, not a measured amount with units or decimals.
initial_application: The request was directly applied by 88048ff4f8421ce558428a51755d7109e668f52d on 2020-01-14, changing the old PackagedProductDefinition spreadsheet type from Quantity to integer and updating examples from Quantity-with-unit XML to primitive integer XML. Later source rework preserved the integer type in the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and MedicinalProductPackaged maps to it. FHIR-29692 later renamed PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging; that issue is already represented on the combined branch by 4581fc843e50528abaf1b516abfa7f849017d9bf and did not change the quantity type. BR&R minutes confirm the 2020-01-14 vote, and the only relevant Zulip hit found was a resolved local parsing question that agreed packaging.quantity should be an integer.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current combined branch defines PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.quantity with type integer, has no remaining PackagedProductDefinition.package.quantity path in active PackagedProductDefinition source, and current examples serialize the value as an integer primitive.

related_jiras.note: Renamed the relevant element family from PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging while preserving the integer quantity type; it is already represented on the combined branch.
